_note: Étape 1 : prompt (jusqu'à 30 s de lecture, puis 5 min). Étape 2 : followUp (3 min, sans préparation). Guide 2026 §4.3.

items.prompt: Some people prefer to work for a large company, while others prefer a small one. Which would you choose, and why?
items.followUp: You explained your choice. Now describe a disadvantage of the option you chose and how you would deal with it.

items.prompt: Should universities require all students to take courses outside their main field of study? Explain your opinion.
items.followUp: Think about students who are working while studying. How would such a requirement affect them?

items.prompt: Do you think smartphones have improved or damaged the quality of our relationships? Give reasons.
items.followUp: What rules, if any, should families set about phone use at home?

items.prompt: What is the most effective thing an individual can do to protect the environment? Explain your answer.
items.followUp: Some people say individual actions are useless compared to what governments can do. Do you agree?

items.prompt: Would you rather live in a big city or in the countryside? Explain your preference.
items.followUp: Describe how your ideal place to live might change when you are older.

items.prompt: Many people find it difficult to maintain healthy habits. What do you think is the main reason for this?
items.followUp: What could employers do to help their staff live healthier lives?

items.prompt: Is it better to travel alone or with other people? Explain your opinion.
items.followUp: Describe a situation in which your answer might be different.

items.prompt: Should schools teach children how to manage money? Why or why not?
items.followUp: At what age should children start receiving pocket money, and how should it be used?

items.prompt: Do you think people today have more free time or less free time than in the past? Explain.
items.followUp: How do you think people will spend their free time in twenty years?

items.prompt: Some people believe that reading novels is a waste of time. Do you agree or disagree?
items.followUp: Which kinds of entertainment, other than books, can also help people learn?

items.prompt: Should governments tax unhealthy food and drinks to improve public health? Explain your view.
items.followUp: Who should be responsible for teaching people about nutrition: families, schools or the media?

items.prompt: Is it important to love your job, or is a good salary enough? Explain your answer.
items.followUp: Describe what an employer could offer, besides money, to keep good employees.

items.prompt: Is online learning as effective as learning in a classroom? Explain your opinion.
items.followUp: Which subjects do you think are especially difficult to learn online, and why?

items.prompt: Should children be allowed to use social media before the age of fifteen? Give reasons.
items.followUp: How could social media platforms make their services safer for young users?

items.prompt: Is it better to have a few close friends or many acquaintances? Explain.
items.followUp: How has technology changed the way people make and keep friends?

items.prompt: Should cars be banned from city centers? Explain your opinion.
items.followUp: How would such a ban affect people who live outside the city but work there?
